svg.title: Figure 3 — UML Component diagram — application components and interfaces

g.text: Figure 3 — UML Component diagram — application components and interfaces
The four packages are the Spring Modulith application modules. HTTP is an adapter role,
not a fifth horizontal module: each inbound adapter lives inside the module whose use case
it drives. GoF Adapter labels identify boundary translation roles; Strategy seams identify
interchangeable implementations; the analysis application service acts as a Facade over
orchestration. Structural presence does not imply first acceptance.
